name: Holtburg
summary: Holtburg is one of the first Aluvian villages (founded 2 PY by settlers from Cragstone logging the Tiofor Wood) and the classic Aluvian starter town. It stands on a hill overlooking the River Prosper: the drop point and Life Stone sit on a flat hilltop square (z 94) ringed by stone-and-timber halls, a brick meeting hall, a pitched-roof tower house and a mossy stone tower with ancient columns and candelabras; a lower terrace (z 66) north of it holds a row of Aluvian halls with brass lanterns and the crafting forges, the well and the Nullified Drudge statue on its plinth, and below that the wide River Prosper (z 28) with a bamboo fishing hut. The Town Network portal sits on the western slope and two spire-roofed towers with torches rise on the hills to the south-east.

shots.standingOrder: Rise straight up the south wall of the hilltop hall and over its roof to reveal the lower town and the River Prosper below; stay 6 m off the wall and 5 m above the roof.
shots.notes: Film-opening rise: lens starts 1.9 m above the hilltop grass beside the Life Stone, staring up the 10 m south wall of the brick hilltop hall (S121, top z 104.2), climbs 20.6 m straight up the face and over the roofline while pitching from +15 to -9 deg, revealing the lower-town rooftops and the River Prosper 270 m north (subject hidden for the first ~9.75 s by design, clear from t=10). Morning sun from the east side-lights the hall. Clearance: wall 13 m ahead at the start, 12.4 m at the end, end z 116.5 = 12.3 m above the roof; nearest prop a candelabra 4.5 m; vmax 2.6 m/s. JEV candidate if the film's hero budget allows.

shots.standingOrder: Look up at the Holtburg Life Stone from just above the grass with the morning sky behind it; creep 1 m closer and keep 2 m from the crystal.
shots.notes: Life Stone detail: lens 0.7 m above the hilltop grass ESE of the crystal (bearing 120, sun behind the camera), looking up at the 3.6 m sparkling stone against the morning sky and creeping 1 m closer. Alcott the greeter stands 3 m NE of the stone, off-axis. Clearance: 4 m from the stone centre (>= 2.2 m from its 3 m-wide setup bounds), no static within 4 m (WBT query-radius 0 hits).

shots.standingOrder: Glide east along the timbered fronts of the lower-town halls at walking pace, 9 m off the walls and 3 m up, past the forges and lanterns; nothing may cross between lens and wall.
shots.notes: The town's one facade pan (Aluvian timber-and-stone halls): glides 34 m east along the south fronts of S118, S114 and S117 on the lower terrace, 7.5-9 m off the walls and 2.6-3.8 m above the sloping street, ending on the brass lanterns and the Fletching Forge glow. Morning sun rakes the facades from the right. Clearance: nearest wall 7.5 m, no static/scenery within 4 m of the line (query-radius 0 hits), vmax 4.5 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Skim south 4 m above the River Prosper toward Holtburg on its hill; stay over open water and 30 m from the banks.
shots.notes: Water: skims south 4 m above the running water of the River Prosper (terrain type WaterRunning, z 28) for 80 m with Holtburg's lower terrace and hilltop roofs rising ahead (the roofs peek over the terrace edge, the town on its hill as in the lore). Path given explicitly (32556,34935)->(32556,34855); whole path over water, banks and trees >= 31.5 m away; vmax 7.3 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Hover 30 m above the hilltop square and turn slowly clockwise from the river round over the Tiofor woods and the eastern towers; hold height, no drift.
shots.notes: Closing panorama: hovers 30 m above the hilltop square (z 124, 17 m above the tallest hilltop roof 106.7) and turns 300 deg clockwise from the river north through the eastern spire towers, the southern woods and back west; clouds on. Clearance 19.8 m to the nearest roof; no translation.
